newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kesko sees 1996 profit at 1995 level.
newsitem.headline: Kesko sees 1996 profit at 1995 level.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler Kesko Oy said on Thursday it expected full-year 1996 profit to be at last year's level, when profit before extras was 689 million markka.
"The group's profit before extraordinary items and taxes in 1996 is expected to be at last year's level," Kesko said in its January-August interim report.

Its acquisitions this year of Tuko Oy and Kaukomarkkinat Oy meant Kesko's net sales would rise substantially, the company said. In January-August, Kesko's net sales climbed almost 25 percent to 21.3 billion markka.
As ample capital was spent on the acquisitions, Kesko said its net financial gains would "fall clearly".
In January-August, net financial gains fell nearly 48 percent on the year-ago period to 77 million markka.
